title: Brief CLI deadline test fails under host load
body: Outcome: test/rules/brief-allowlist.test.ts:102 'brief CLI handles maximum-sized section lines before its one-second deadline' passes deterministically under host load or measures work instead of wall time (D12: no retry). Evidence: PR #192 regression run at load 15.6 failed spawnSync ETIMEDOUT 1849 ms; three isolated reruns passed. Proof: the test asserts a bound that does not depend on host load.
